妮娜的生活方式(Nina's Way of Living): 一篇关于节日文化的B1记叙文:妮娜的经历、感受与成长。

Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The holiday plan looked quieter than usual that evening. Nina wrote down every idea in a small notebook. For example, she cooks for her in-laws on Sundays.

Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Little by little, things began to change. Owen advised Nina to try drawing as a new hobby. Also, millions of pilgrims travel to Lourdes every spring.

Nina is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. For example, warm soil speeds up the germination of tomato seeds.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Nina prefers cloudy weather when running in the museum. People around Nina often share different ideas about the holiday plan. Also, mom is in the kitchen.
The spring market has become an important part of daily life. Nina thanked Owen for the honest advice. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
